name: LinkKind
doc: How agents traverse an off-mesh link. Animation reads it from NavAgentState.traversal (an intent), never through a call.

variants.name: walk
variants.doc: Straight walk at agent speed (narrow passages, scripted moves).

variants.name: jump
variants.doc: Ballistic arc with arc_height; plays a jump animation.

variants.name: ladder
variants.doc: Vertical climb at reduced speed; plays a ladder animation.

variants.name: door
variants.doc: Passable only while open; agents wait at the start and request opening.

variants.name: elevator
variants.doc: Passable only while the cabin is present; riders wait, then ride.
